title: Time Jump: 09:00, Lot on Hold, 4.9 Days

fields.scenarioTitle: Forty Percent — IV Fluid Allocation & Substitution Safety
fields.narration: It is now 09:00 on Monday, October 5, 2026. Incident Commander Dale Pruitt has opened the command center in Conference Room C, extension 3690, and the Drug Shortage Team is at the table for its opening huddle. The first full Level 3 meeting is set for 11:00, then every 8 hours. Since the 08:20 recount, things have got worse. At 08:40 the manufacturer's customer service put a hold on lot NS-26-0917A of sodium chloride 0.9% 1000 mL. It was the last lot filled before the plant lost power, and its sterilization records are incomplete. Prairie Ridge has 890 of those bags in the stockroom. Storeroom technician Marcus Bell, CPhT, has tagged them DO NOT USE – QUARANTINE. That leaves 1,670 usable bags of 1000 mL normal saline. At 340 bags a day, that is 4.9 days on hand. The FDA shortage listing goes live in 30 minutes. The first allocated wholesaler truck, with 952 bags of NS for the week, does not arrive until Thursday at 05:30. Patient Relations now has 19 calls logged. The ICU is still flushing from opened 250 mL bags under its 08:05 memo, and 6 West is still using prefilled syringes. No single notice has gone out yet to the units or the medical staff. The clock is running again.
worldState: Clock: 09:00, Monday, October 5, 2026. The command center is open in Conference Room C (ext. 3690). Incident Commander Dale Pruitt is chairing, with the Drug Shortage Team present.

Manufacturer hold at 08:40: sodium chloride 0.9% 1000 mL, NDC 0000-1234-01 (fictional), lot NS-26-0917A, exp 09/2028. Incomplete sterilization records. 890 bags are in the stockroom, tagged DO NOT USE – QUARANTINE by Marcus Bell, CPhT.
Usable NaCl 0.9% 1000 mL: 2,560 total − 890 on hold = 1,670 bags. At the 14-day ADU of 340 bags/day, that is 4.9 days on hand.
LR 1000 mL is unchanged: 700 bags, ADU 120, 5.8 days on hand. NaCl 0.9% 250 mL minibags are unchanged: 3,050, ADU 410, 7.4 days on hand.
Wholesaler allocation is 40% of baseline-period usage. The first allocated truck (952 NS 1000 mL, 336 LR 1000 mL, 1,148 minibags) is due Thursday, October 8, 05:30.
FDA Drug Shortage Database listing of all three products as 'Currently in Shortage' goes live at 09:30 CT.
Manufacturer restart estimate is still 7 to 10 days, which it calls an estimate, not a commitment. An emergency allocation request would bring only a few cases, with no ship date.
Conflicting flush practice continues: the ICU draws flushes from opened 250 mL bags (08:05 memo), and 6 West uses 10 mL prefilled syringes with no KVO (07:55 memo).
No unit notice, medical staff message or single page with shared numbers has been issued. Patient Relations has 19 calls logged, mostly from Wednesday surgery and infusion center patients.
The reporter's 2 p.m. deadline and the North Iowa NewsChannel noon live hit are still pending.
fields.facilitatorNote: If players don't raise it, ask: 'What is the Level now, and who declared it?' Usable NS at 4.9 days and the 40% allocation each meet Level 3 on their own (Drug Shortage Plan 3), so the Incident Commander with the CMO owns the call. Push the CPM to keep lot NS-26-0917A physically separate from usable stock and out of cabinet restock. The lot is held as suspect product and has not been found illegitimate. Watch for a Level 3 conservation and substitution notice under IV Fluid Conservation SOP PH-22-A, and for one CNO unit notice that withdraws both flush memos (Clinical Plan 6: correction within 2 hours). Note that elective deferral (Plan 5, step 5) only triggers below 3 days of NS 1000 mL, which has not happened yet. Ask what the team will record at the 8-hour meeting (Plan 8), and whether it will send patient-care impact to the FDA shortage mailbox. If anyone suggests buying from an unknown seller, remind them of the Director of Pharmacy's rule: no product without a lot number or from an unlicensed seller.

instructorNote: This card escalates the situation with a quarantined lot that drops usable NS to 4.9 days on hand. Players should confirm Level 3 from the recounted usable number and turn the conflicting unit practices into one consistent notice. Watch for anyone counting the 890 quarantined bags as available or saying the 06:30 truck instead of Thursday 05:30.
